name: observabilityadmin
description: You can use Amazon CloudWatch Observability Admin to discover and understand the state of telemetry configuration in CloudWatch for your Amazon Web Services Organization or account.

subcommands.name: create-centralization-rule-for-organization
subcommands.description: Creates a centralization rule that applies across an Amazon Web Services Organization.

subcommands.name: create-s3-table-integration
subcommands.description: Creates an integration between CloudWatch and S3 Tables for analytics.

subcommands.name: create-telemetry-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates a telemetry pipeline for processing and transforming telemetry data.

subcommands.name: create-telemetry-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a telemetry rule that defines how telemetry should be configured for Amazon Web Services resources in your account.

subcommands.name: create-telemetry-rule-for-organization
subcommands.description: Creates a telemetry rule that applies across an Amazon Web Services Organization.

subcommands.name: delete-centralization-rule-for-organization
subcommands.description: Deletes an organization-wide centralization rule.

subcommands.name: delete-s3-table-integration
subcommands.description: Deletes an S3 Table integration and its associated data.

subcommands.name: delete-telemetry-pipeline
subcommands.description: Deletes a telemetry pipeline and its associated resources.

subcommands.name: delete-telemetry-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes a telemetry rule from your account.

subcommands.name: delete-telemetry-rule-for-organization
subcommands.description: Deletes an organization-wide telemetry rule.

subcommands.name: get-centralization-rule-for-organization
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a specific organization centralization rule.

subcommands.name: get-s3-table-integration
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specific S3 Table integration, including its configuration, status, and metadata.

subcommands.name: get-telemetry-enrichment-status
subcommands.description: Returns the current status of the resource tags for telemetry feature, which enhances telemetry data with additional resource metadata from Resource Explorer.

subcommands.name: get-telemetry-evaluation-status
subcommands.description: Returns the current onboarding status of the telemetry config feature, including the status of the feature and reason the feature failed to start or stop.

subcommands.name: get-telemetry-evaluation-status-for-organization
subcommands.description: This returns the onboarding status of the telemetry configuration feature for the organization.

subcommands.name: get-telemetry-pipeline
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specific telemetry pipeline, including its configuration, status, and metadata.

subcommands.name: get-telemetry-rule
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a specific telemetry rule in your account.

subcommands.name: get-telemetry-rule-for-organization
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a specific organization telemetry rule.

subcommands.name: list-centralization-rules-for-organization
subcommands.description: Lists all centralization rules in your organization.

subcommands.name: list-resource-telemetry
subcommands.description: Returns a list of telemetry configurations for Amazon Web Services resources supported by telemetry config.

subcommands.name: list-resource-telemetry-for-organization
subcommands.description: Returns a list of telemetry configurations for Amazon Web Services resources supported by telemetry config in the organization.

subcommands.name: list-s3-table-integrations
subcommands.description: Lists all S3 Table integrations in your account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags attached to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: list-telemetry-pipelines
subcommands.description: Returns a list of telemetry pipelines in your account.

subcommands.name: list-telemetry-rules
subcommands.description: Lists all telemetry rules in your account.

subcommands.name: list-telemetry-rules-for-organization
subcommands.description: Lists all telemetry rules in your organization.

subcommands.name: start-telemetry-enrichment
subcommands.description: Enables the resource tags for telemetry feature for your account, which enhances telemetry data with additional resource metadata from Resource Explorer to provide richer context for monitoring and observability.

subcommands.name: start-telemetry-evaluation
subcommands.description: This action begins onboarding the caller Amazon Web Services account to the telemetry config feature.

subcommands.name: start-telemetry-evaluation-for-organization
subcommands.description: This actions begins onboarding the organization and all member accounts to the telemetry config feature.

subcommands.name: stop-telemetry-enrichment
subcommands.description: Disables the resource tags for telemetry feature for your account, stopping the enhancement of telemetry data with additional resource metadata.

subcommands.name: stop-telemetry-evaluation
subcommands.description: This action begins offboarding the caller Amazon Web Services account from the telemetry config feature.

subcommands.name: stop-telemetry-evaluation-for-organization
subcommands.description: This action offboards the Organization of the caller Amazon Web Services account from the telemetry config feature.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for a resource.

subcommands.name: test-telemetry-pipeline
subcommands.description: Tests a pipeline configuration with sample records to validate data processing before deployment.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-centralization-rule-for-organization
subcommands.description: Updates an existing centralization rule that applies across an Amazon Web Services Organization.

subcommands.name: update-telemetry-pipeline
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an existing telemetry pipeline.

subcommands.name: update-telemetry-rule
subcommands.description: Updates an existing telemetry rule in your account.

subcommands.name: update-telemetry-rule-for-organization
subcommands.description: Updates an existing telemetry rule that applies across an Amazon Web Services Organization.

subcommands.name: validate-telemetry-pipeline-configuration
subcommands.description: Validates a pipeline configuration without creating the pipeline.
